LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for California

Anglers aged 16 or older generally need a sport fishing licence in fresh or ocean water. Children and public-pier anglers can still need species report cards.

  • 1 specified day$21.09 USD
  • 2 consecutive days$32.40 USD
  • 10 consecutive days$64.54 USD
  • 365 days$174.14 USD
Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • From Trout Creek to Prosser Creek, release all trout and use artificial flies with barbless hooks.
  • Below Prosser Creek to Nevada, use artificial lures; the seasonal harvest limit is two trout.
  • That lower reach becomes catch-and-release with barbless hooks from 16 November until the last Saturday in April.
  • The first 1,000 feet below the Lake Tahoe outlet dam are closed.

Full California licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
